```plato
//==
// # PointClouds — deformation bodies for the enriched point clouds
//
// The IDeformable3D obligations of the attributed clouds in `pointclouds.types.plato`:
// positions are carried through the mapping and every parallel channel passes
// through unchanged. Normals are NOT re-derived — they stay exact under rigid
// mappings and go stale under bending ones, and only a surface (which a cloud
// does not carry) could say what the corrected normal is.

library PointClouds
{
    // The IDeformable3D obligation: positions deformed; the parallel normals
    // are carried unchanged (stale after a non-rigid mapping).
    Deform(self: OrientedPointCloud3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): OrientedPointCloud3D
        => (self.Positions.Map(mapping), self.Normals);
```
